newsitem.title: USA: Best puts Western National rating on review.
newsitem.headline: Best puts Western National rating on review.

text.p: A.M. Best said on Friday it had placed the "A," or excellent, rating of Western National Life Insurance Co (WNL) under review with positive implications.

The insurance rating company said in a statement that the move followed Friday's announcement by American General Corp that it intended to increase its investment in Western National Corp, WNL's immediate parent, through the purchase of Western National preferred stock.

The acquisition brings American General's total investment in Western National to $400 million. American General will acquire $130 million of participating convertible preferred stock with a stated dividend equivalent to WNC's common stock, or about one percent.
"Best expects that proceeds will be immediately contributed to Western National Life," the statement said.

"Best views the transaction favorably as it further demonstrates American General's strong commitment to WNL, as well as providing Western National with low-cost and needed capital to support its future growth expectations."
